channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Warner Bros. signs $110 billion deal with Paramount
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery has agreed to be acquired by Paramount Skydance in a $110 billion deal signed this morning, according to an audio clip of a global townhall by the company, which was reviewed by Reuters.

item.title: Embassies evacuate in Mideast with Trump ‘not happy’ on Iran
item.description: Countries including the U.S., U.K. and China evacuated embassy staff in the Middle East and issued travel advisories amid concerns about a regional conflict, as President Donald Trump today sounded downbeat about diplomatic talks meant to avert airstrikes on Iran.

item.title: Woman, 21, seriously hurt after vehicle rollover in Hawaii Kai
item.description: A 21-year-old woman is in serious condition after the vehicle she was driving rolled over on Hawaii Kai Drive early this morning.

item.title: Dorsey’s blunt AI warning sharpens debate over jobs and profits
item.description: Jack Dorsey is not the first chief executive to say artificial intelligence will transform work. He may be among the first to act as if it already has — and to say so openly.

item.title: ICE car chase in Newark leads to crash involving children
item.description: A car chase involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents ended in a crash in Newark, New Jersey, on Wednesday morning, leaving three children injured, the Department of Homeland Security said in a statement.

item.title: Trump orders federal agencies to stop using Anthropic AI
item.description: WASHINGTON >> President Donald Trump said today he is directing the government to stop work with Anthropic, and the Pentagon said it would declare the startup a supply-chain risk, dealing a major blow to the artificial intelligence lab after a showdown about technology guardrails.

item.title: Woman fatally shot in Kapolei; suspect in custody, HPD says
item.description: A 26-year-old woman was killed and a teenage girl was injured in a shooting this morning in Kapolei.

item.title: Most high seeds advance through opening round at state wrestling
item.description: Hunter Berger woke up this morning with a smile on his face, but this one had a little extra on it.

item.title: Hawaii board fines helicopter operator $10K for unauthorized commercial activity
item.description: The Hawaii Board of Land & Natural Resources today fined Trident Adventures LLC $10,000 for unauthorized commercial activities within the waters of Shark’s Cove, Three Tables, and Waimea Bay on Oahu’s North Shore.

item.title: Neil Sedaka, singing craftsman of memorable pop songs, dies at 86
item.description: Neil Sedaka, who went from classical music prodigy to precocious songwriter to teenage idol to pop music fixture in a celebrated career that spanned seven decades, died Friday in Los Angeles. He was 86.
